# WeCode4U

> WeCode4U is a custom software development company founded in 1994, headquartered in Jaipur, India, serving clients in the US, UK, Australia, Canada, and worldwide. We build enterprise web applications, mobile apps, cloud infrastructure, and data platforms with dedicated senior engineering teams. ISO 27001 and ISO 27701 certified.

Key facts:
- Founded: 1994 (30+ years of software delivery)
- Services: custom app & product development, data engineering, AI & intelligent development, enterprise mobility, cloud infrastructure, quality engineering
- Certifications: ISO 27001 (information security), ISO 27701 (privacy)
- Engagement models: dedicated development teams, project-based delivery, staff augmentation
- Clients: US, UK, Australia, Canada, India — enterprise and growth-stage companies
- Contact: support@wecode4u.com
